name: PillSync
description: Track up to 5 medications with 3 daily alarms each and up to 3 snoozes per alarm.

configFields.label: Medication 1 Name
configFields.description: Display name for Medication 1.
configFields.validationMessage: Up to 16 letters, digits, spaces, underscores, or hyphens.

configFields.label: Medication 1 Enabled
configFields.description: Enable daily reminders for Medication 1.

configFields.label: Med 1 Alarm 1 (HH:MM or OFF)
configFields.description: First daily alarm time in 24h HH:MM format (e.g. 09:00) or OFF.
configFields.validationMessage: Use 24h HH:MM format (00:00 to 23:59) or OFF.

configFields.label: Med 1 Alarm 2 (HH:MM or OFF)
configFields.description: Second daily alarm time in 24h HH:MM format (e.g. 10:00) or OFF.
configFields.validationMessage: Use 24h HH:MM format (00:00 to 23:59) or OFF.

configFields.label: Med 1 Alarm 3 (HH:MM or OFF)
configFields.description: Third daily alarm time in 24h HH:MM format (e.g. 18:00) or OFF.
configFields.validationMessage: Use 24h HH:MM format (00:00 to 23:59) or OFF.
